decisive_items: basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
response.rationale: R3 is anchored by pathognomonic basophilic/shadow cells and a chalky-white lobulated solid tumor with a hard nodule, fitting pilomatrixoma. R1 relies only on nonspecific multilocular spaces and dilated lymphatics above the tumor, which can be secondary changes and lack the diagnostic solid tumor histology; cystic hygroma would also be expected to be soft and in a typical lymphatic distribution.
